legacyObserved.behavior: Browser-owned WebViews are saved/closed when background runtime disabled, except pending own Android permission/file-picker handoff. Existing system DownloadManager tasks may continue.
legacyObserved.notGlobal: This is not permission for one browser Activity to destroy unrelated subapp sessions or shared host runtime.

geckoSource.create: SDK recommends binding to process lifetime; create throws while another Gecko instance active
geckoSource.shutdown: invalidates ALL attached sessions and force-quits Gecko thread; not a per-browser-page background operation
geckoSource.boundary: No shutdown/recreate or process-death runtime test inferred from source.

v2Ownership.scope: own browser session group/window and its admitted page tasks
v2Ownership.normalHide: release view only when needed and setActive(false) explicitly; this alone does not close session or prove work ended
backgroundDisabled: identify actual own-window/own-OS-flow transition, not merely any Activity onPause
invalidate page admissions/gesture credits and cancel obsolete prompts by exact generations
request bounded checkpoint only under current epoch/persistence/privacy policy; no silent claim latest state saved
cancel or settle browser-page-owned transfer work, retaining actual slot until underlying work ends
close browser-owned GeckoSessions, do not shut down shared GeckoRuntime
leave separately owned Outlook/music/system published downloads subject to their own explicit policies
v2Ownership.platformWait: Do not mistake own OS permission/file-picker Activity transition for leaving the app; keep exact outstanding result ownership, no late result into a new page.
v2Ownership.restart: Reattach/create only after source/data and permission-expiry reconciliation gates, using latest committed admissible snapshot; never reset autoplay/fresh login or owner grant.
v2Ownership.memoryClaim: Closing browser sessions is not zero process-group memory or deletion of Gecko profile data.

pendingCases: own permission/file picker while background setting off
switch browser to music versus app background
checkpoint callback late/failure and still stopping private page work
close only browser group while other subapp plays under existing explicit playback grant
resume cannot inherit expired engine permission allow
